title: clone
description: Clones a set of blocks from one region to another.

begin.title: begin
begin.description: A `vector` that specifies the location in `x`, `y`, and `z` coordinates of `float` type.

end.title: end
end.description: A `vector` that specifies the location in `x`, `y`, and `z` coordinates of `float` type.

destination.title: destination
destination.description: A `vector` that specifies the location in `x`, `y`, and `z` coordinates of `float` type. The lower northwest corner of the region being cloned.

maskmode.title: maskMode
maskmode.description: An `enum` that filters the blocks being cloned. If type `masked`, copy non-air blocks.

clonemode.title: cloneMode
clonemode.description: An `enum` that is one of type `force`, `move`, or `normal`. Default: `normal`.

tilename.title: tileName
tilename.description: An `enum` that must be the `block name` of the blocks that are to be cloned.

blockstates.title: blockStates
blockstates.description: An `array` of block states. Specifies the block  states to use for the cloned blocks.
